title: Jubilee Garden — The World That Can Walk

evidence.author: Static Collective / WORLD-FORGE-001 demonstration
evidence.source: new, authored example; not imported from Minecraft witness #101

quest: Bring a seed through seven rooms without mistaking an offer for an accomplished act.

stations.label: The Garden
stations.message: A seed is offered. Nothing has been planted outside this fictional world.

stations.label: Cartridge Forge
stations.message: A candidate practice is drafted. This is a model, not a verified transferable skill.

stations.label: Lemon Press
stations.message: A fictional paper field-card is prepared for review; it is not published.

stations.label: Giving Tree
stations.message: A voluntary gift is recorded as an in-game gesture. No payment or debt exists.

stations.label: Council Fire
stations.message: The local room is asked. No human consent is inferred.

stations.label: Crossing Gate
stations.message: An in-game crossing receipt is observed. External reality remains unverified.

stations.label: World Machine
stations.message: The proposed cartridge arrives at HOLD. A receiving world may refuse it.
